def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    """Return a regex pattern that matches datetime strings according to C strftime format fmt."""
    mapping = {
        '%Y': r'\d{4}',
        '%y': r'\d{2}',
        '%m': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%b': r'[A-Za-z]{3}',
        '%B': r'[A-Za-z]+',
        '%d': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%e': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%H': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%I': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%p': r'(AM|PM|am|pm)',
        '%M': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%S': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%f': r'\d{1,6}',
        '%z': r'([+-]\d{4}|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|Z)',
        '%Z': r'[A-Za-z]{2,5}',
        '%j': r'\d{1,3}',
        '%U': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%W': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%c': r'.+?',  # generic
        '%x': r'.+?',
        '%X': r'.+?',
        '%%': r'%',
    }
    # Build regex by scanning fmt
    regex = ''
    i = 0
    while i < len(fmt):
        if fmt[i] == '%':
            if i+1 < len(fmt):
                directive = fmt[i:i+2]
                if directive in mapping:
                    regex += mapping[directive]
                else:
                    # unknown directive, treat as literal
                    regex += re.escape(directive)
                i += 2
            else:
                regex += re.escape('%')
                i += 1
        else:
            regex += re.escape(fmt[i])
            i += 1
    return regex
